verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de's docs show a notarization API for submitting existing documents, managing signers, and detecting signature fields, but there is no evidence of AI drafting of contract content (e.g., an NDA) nor of any MCP server or agent-facing interface — only a REST API for notarization/incorporation/translation workflows. The story's core capabilities (AI drafting + MCP server) are unevidenced.
